goals.title: MCP daemon client transport expansion
goals.objective: Extend daemon-backed MCP submission beyond the current TCP-only path. Add UDS support behind cfg(unix) and HTTP/SSE daemon client support if the existing daemon protocol supports it; wire the transport selection through tdw-app-client, tdw-mcp config/env overrides, and fail-closed unsupported transport handling. Preserve stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP server behavior.

goals.title: Worker distributed production backend
goals.objective: Add a production distributed worker backend for tdw-worker using the selected Postgres/RiverQueue-style durable scheduler path. Mirror the SQLite durable scheduler contract for enqueue, priority lease, lease expiry, retries, dead-lettering, idempotent completion, stats, and migration/config behavior. Keep local SQLite support intact.
goals.evidence: Implemented PgWorkerQueue behind postgres feature with durable migration/config/readiness docs; mirrored SQLite enqueue, priority lease, lease expiry/reap, retry/dead-letter, idempotent complete, stats, and env-gated integration coverage.
